title: Stage 2 Architecture Specification Output
description: Opinionated architecture spec generated from Stage 1 constraints plus interview-back answers. Stage 2 of the Speakspec pipeline. All fields required. Every architecture_decision MUST include at least one ruled_out alternative.

system_overview.description: 2-4 sentence description of the system as designed.

rationale.description: Chosen on technical fit only. Never on familiarity.

overridden_by_user.description: True only if the user explicitly stated a language preference that overrode the technical-fit choice.

quality_goals.description: Performance, availability, maintainability, security goals derived from constraints (arc42-style).

architecture_decisions.description: The core IP. Each significant decision with rationale, confidence, and ruled-out alternatives. Maps 1:1 to a generated ADR file.

title.description: Short decision title, becomes the ADR slug.

ruled_out.description: At least one rejected alternative. Neutral output is the lowest-value output.

oss_components.description: Existing well-maintained OSS libraries to use instead of building. Checked against the OSS knowledge base before recommending custom work.

version.description: Pinned or minimum version. Use 'latest-stable' only if a specific version is genuinely unknown.

what_not_to_build.description: Explicit list of things NOT to build for this problem type. Specific, not generic.

risk_flags.description: Issues the user did not mention but a senior architect would flag proactively.

open_questions.description: Ambiguities to resolve before building. Low-confidence decisions must surface a specific question here.

time_estimate.description: Rough solo-builder estimate, e.g. '3-5 days to first working slice'.

constraints.description: Hard technical constraints that MUST appear verbatim in the agent context file.
